statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations
The patient presents with episodes of dizziness
The symptoms are concerning for arrhythmia
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The service is to capture continuous rhythm data and correlate symptomatic events with potential cardiac dysrhythmias
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197
The denial reason is that required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
SilverBridge Advantage requires all non-emergency diagnostic monitoring services to be pre-approved
